infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ShotTraxx captures GPS when you pick a club to mark where you hit from.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ShotTraxx uses the microphone only when you tap Say a club so you can name a club like “seven iron”.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: ShotTraxx uses speech recognition to match what you say to a club in your bag.
